def: To free from the bonds of marriage; to divorce. [Obs.] Ld.Berners.
To sever from the neck; to behead; to decapitate.The decollated head of St. John the Baptist. Burke.
Of or pertaining to the Phylactolæma.
A fox (Vulpes Niloticus) of Northern Africa.
To strike; to beat; to give a heavy or resounding blow to; tothrash; to make with whacks. [Colloq.]Rodsmen were whackingtheir way through willow brakes. G. W. Cable.
Any bird of the genus Colius and allied genera. They inhabitAfrica.
One of a faction in Italy, in the 12th and 13th centuries,which favored the German emperors, and opposed the Guelfs, oradherents of the poses. Brande & C.
Pertaining to the femur or thigh; as, the femoral artery."Femoral habiliments." Sir W. Scott.
To run or strike against each other; to encounter; to clash; tojostle. Shak.The chariots shall rage in the streets; they shall justle one againstanother in the broad ways. Nahum ii. 4.
A kind of coarse cloth for packing goods. [Obs.]
